description:
Extend the canonical construction path to non-primitive lengths: callers supply only $n$ for a derived canonical element of order $n$, or supply an explicit $n$-th root of unity.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Non-primitive construction works with the derived canonical order-$n$ element and with an explicitly supplied root of unity, and the two agree when the explicit root is the canonical one.
- [hard] REQ-02: Roots of wrong order and lengths violating $\gcd(n,q)=1$ report typed errors.
title: Construction at non-primitive lengths with both root conventions
